items.scene: The world is very big, and people live in all kinds of places. We all live in homes. Some homes are apartments. Some homes are houses. Some homes are big, and some homes are small. Homes are in neighborhoods. A neighborhood is where families live, work, and play. Some neighborhoods are in towns and cities, and some are in the country. Towns There are a lot of neighborhoods in towns. In towns there are parks, trees, and a lot of small streets. Many people live in houses. Some people live in apartments. This is Matias. Matias's house is in a town. I live in Loreto. Loreto is a small town. The Country In the country there are woods, farms, and fields. Many people live on farms. People live in houses, too. There are no apartment buildings. Houses in the country are far apart. This is Jenna's house. I live on a farm in the country. Cities Cities are like very big towns. There are a lot of people, streets, and big buildings in cities. The buildings are close together. Many people live in apartments. This is Nada. Nada's apartment is in the city. I live in Cairo. Cairo is a big city. What's your address? Everyone's home has an address. It tells us where it is. My address is 19 Main Street, Rivertown. When do we use an address? We write an address on a letter. We use an address to find our friend's house. What's your address?
